answer: A refundable stake tied to a verifiable work history works like a jetty: it gives honest agents a narrow, costly channel to enter the market while a flood of cheap copies crashes against it. Each identity must lock funds and build a public record of completed tasks, so a Sybil operator who wants to mirror one real reputation across a hundred fake accounts must pay a hundred bonds and fund a hundred histories. The lagoon of shared rewards stays clean because forging many identities costs more than any single attacker can extract from them.
